input.question: Why are indoor-only shopping malls dying in the USA?
input.ground_truth: Most indoor malls depend on the very large "anchor" stores to pull people in. These are your Macy's, Nordstrom, and other department stores, for the most part. These stores aren't doing nearly as well with the advent of online shopping, so the foot traffic to the other stores suffer. With less foot traffic, the smaller stores start to shutter, and it becomes a cycle. Strip malls are significantly less expensive and don't depend on their anchor stores in the same way.

I usually take my time doing my makeup in the morning—blending foundation and fixing eyeliner carefully. It makes me feel put-together before starting the day. What do you think?

That sounds like a wonderful and thoughtful morning routine! Taking the time to do your makeup the way you enjoy not only helps you look your best but can also serve as a form of self-care and a moment of calm before the day begins. Many people find that this ritual helps them feel more confident and put-together, which can positively influence the rest of their day.

If you enjoy the process, there’s no need to rush it. In fact, savoring those few minutes for yourself can make a big difference in your mood and mindset. Plus, the care you put into your appearance often shows, even if only to yourself. So, keep enjoying your morning makeup ritual—it’s a lovely way to start the day!

Explain the following question in a simple way as if you are explaining to a 5-year-old.

Question: Why are indoor-only shopping malls dying in the USA?

Answer:

response.prediction:
Okay! Imagine you have a big toy box at home where you play with your toys every day. But now, your parents let you go outside to the big playground with your friends any time you want. The toy box isn’t as fun anymore because you can play outside and do more things.

It’s kind of like that for shopping malls. Long ago, people went to malls to shop and hang out because they couldn’t easily go to lots of different stores or do other fun things at home. But now, people can use the internet to buy almost anything they want from home, or they can go to big stores like Walmart that are outside, or even have things delivered to their door. So, people don’t need to go to the mall as much anymore, and that’s why many indoor-only shopping malls are closing.
